description: Traffic Flow is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Jing Chen (Hangzhou Dianzi University). PEMS03, PEMS04, PEMS07 and PEMS08, these four datasets are constructed from four areas in California. All the data was collected from the Caltrans Performance Measurement System (PeMS) and the spatial adjacency matrices for each dataset were built using a distance-based real road network. PEMS03 has 358 sensors with a duration of 3 months. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
